args.message:
Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

round_money documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build's test_money.py to fail.
Use Decimal.quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66.
Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

args.head: fix/FIN-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
Fixes the failing nightly build of `tests/test_money.py`.

## Problem
`src/money.py::round_money` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually called `Decimal.quantize` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. As a result, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`, and the test below failed:

```python
assert round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")
assert round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")  # banker's rounding
```

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and pass it to `quantize`, so the implementation matches the docstring and FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

cc @alex for review
